opening.argument: The speaker does not merely demonstrate an account; he promotes joining the Forsage earning system and directs viewers toward a recruitment-based opportunity. He asks viewers to examine “what is his earnings if he is a team size,” tying the account’s earnings to team structure, while the displayed account shows 8 835 BUSD in profits, a personal link, a “Sign up” button, and an “invited by” relationship. That combination points to an upline and partner structure in which earning depends on recruitment, rather than a neutral technical demonstration. The closing instruction is explicit: “if you wants to start fosx then contact me fast.” Together, the recruitment-linked account features, profit display, and urgent invitation to begin establish the promoted tiered earning pitch.
